mapper.select: SELECT P.PERM_ID AS PERMISSION_ID, P.PERM_CD AS PERMISSION_CODE, P.PERM_NM AS PERMISSION_NAME, P.PERM_EXPLN AS DESCRIPTION, P.PERM_ENABLED AS ENABLED FROM TB_PERMISSION P ORDER BY P.PERM_CD

SELECT R.ROLE_ID, R.ROLE_CD AS ROLE_CODE, R.ROLE_NM AS ROLE_NAME, R.ROLE_EXPLN AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(PC.PERMISSION_COUNT, 0) AS PERMISSION_COUNT, NVL(EC.ASSIGNED_EMPLOYEE_COUNT, 0) AS ASSIGNED_EMPLOYEE_COUNT FROM TB_ROLE R LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ROLE_ID, COUNT(1) AS PERMISSION_COUNT FROM TB_PERMISSION_ROLE_MAPPING GROUP BY ROLE_ID ) PC ON PC.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ROLE_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT EMP_ID) AS ASSIGNED_EMPLOYEE_COUNT FROM TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT WHERE ENABLED = 'Y' GROUP BY ROLE_ID ) EC ON EC.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID ORDER BY R.ROLE_ID
SELECT R.ROLE_ID, R.ROLE_CD AS ROLE_CODE, R.ROLE_NM AS ROLE_NAME, R.ROLE_EXPLN AS DESCRIPTION FROM TB_ROLE R WHERE R.ROLE_ID = #{roleId}

SELECT P.PERM_ID AS PERMISSION_ID, P.PERM_CD AS PERMISSION_CODE, P.PERM_NM AS PERMISSION_NAME, P.PERM_EXPLN AS DESCRIPTION, P.PERM_ENABLED AS ENABLED FROM TB_PERMISSION_ROLE_MAPPING PRM JOIN TB_PERMISSION P ON P.PERM_ID = PRM.PERM_ID WHERE PRM.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} ORDER BY P.PERM_CD

SELECT RA.ROLE_ASSIGN_ID AS ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_ID, E.EMP_ID, E.EMP_NM AS EMPLOYEE_NAME, E.DEPT_CD, D.DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NAME, RA.SCOPE_TYPE_CD, RA.SCOPE_ID, RA.ENABLED FROM TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT RA JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = RA.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD WHERE RA.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} ORDER BY E.EMP_ID, RA.ROLE_ASSIGN_ID

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_PERMISSION P WHERE P.PERM_ENABLED = 'Y' AND P.PERM_ID IN
#{permissionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ROLE ( ROLE_ID, ROLE_CD, ROLE_NM, ROLE_EXPLN, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(ROLE_ID), 0) + 1 FROM TB_ROLE), #{roleCd}, #{roleNm}, #{roleExpln}, NVL(#{frstRgtrId}, 0), SYSDATE, NVL(#{lastMdfrId}, 0), SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ROLE SET ROLE_NM = #{roleName}, ROLE_EXPLN = #{description}, LAST_MDFR_ID = NVL(#{lastModifierId}, 0), LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ROLE_ID = #{roleId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT RA.EMP_ID FROM TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT RA WHERE RA.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND RA.ENABLED = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT ( ROLE_ASSIGN_ID, ROLE_ID, EMP_ID, SCOPE_TYPE_CD, SCOPE_ID, ENABLED ) SELECT (SELECT NVL(MAX(ROLE_ASSIGN_ID), 0) FROM TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY RA.ROLE_ASSIGN_ID) AS ROLE_ASSIGN_ID, #{replacementRoleId} AS ROLE_ID, RA.EMP_ID, RA.SCOPE_TYPE_CD, RA.SCOPE_ID, RA.ENABLED FROM TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT RA WHERE RA.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT EXISTING_RA WHERE EXISTING_RA.ROLE_ID = #{replacementRoleId} AND EXISTING_RA.EMP_ID = RA.EMP_ID AND EXISTING_RA.SCOPE_TYPE_CD = RA.SCOPE_TYPE_CD AND NVL(EXISTING_RA.SCOPE_ID, '__NULL__') = NVL(RA.SCOPE_ID, '__NULL__') )
